items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I would imagine. Is Tony Prentice still living? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Right. Well, I just... I think Tony recorded with John Detroit, didn't he?

ctx.x: He's still around New York the last time I...
I would imagine. Is Tony Prentice still living?

No, he is not. He's passed on. I hadn't talked to his wit or anything. I never did really know her. Now, that's a fellow who did something that most people don't realize. If you had to choose one musician in this country who really started the ball rolling right time, I'd say it was Tony Prentice. Because he got a couple of writers in New York interested in it. And he would record them with his band and his trio. And from that, they wrote a book. And you never know what will happen out of an idea of something…
